full_prompt_en: A square expressive painting shows a group of riders approaching through a dusty open space against an abstract wash of orange, cream, blue, and gray. The upper left glows with warm red-orange color, while cooler blue-green and charcoal patches gather toward the upper right. Across the center, several dark-haired figures sit on horses whose heads and front legs emerge unevenly from the haze. A rider in yellow stands out near the middle of the group, with red-clothed figures and darker silhouettes at either side. The horses are arranged at different depths: the nearer animals are broader and more defined, while those behind are reduced to quick dark marks and pale openings. Their forward movement is suggested by tilted heads, uneven legs, and repeated vertical brushstrokes rather than sharply drawn anatomy. In the lower third, loose gray and cream strokes break around the animals' hooves and dissolve into a nearly featureless pale foreground. Warm pigment around the leftmost riders meets a cooler turquoise field around the rightmost figures. The lighting is diffuse and atmospheric, with no hard cast shadows; the pale ground and light coats carry the strongest highlights beneath the darker riders. Broad scraped marks, dry black lines, and thin translucent color make parts of the scene appear unfinished, while small saturated accents hold the group together. The overall composition gathers the riders into a compact central band, using energetic broken edges and warm-cool contrast to convey motion through haze.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形的表现性绘画呈现一群骑手穿过尘雾弥漫的开阔地迎面而来，背景是橙色、乳白、蓝色和灰色的抽象晕染。左上方泛着温暖的红橙色，较冷的蓝绿与炭灰色块则聚集在右上方。画面中央横向排列着数名深发人物，骑在马背上；马头与前腿从雾气里不均匀地显现。中央附近一名穿黄色衣服的骑手格外醒目，两侧有穿红衣的人物和更暗的剪影。马匹处在不同纵深：近处的形体较宽、较清楚，后方则缩成迅速的深色笔痕和浅色空隙。倾斜的头、参差的腿与重复的纵向笔触暗示向前的运动，而不是依赖清晰勾出的解剖细节。下部三分之一处，松散的灰色与乳白笔触在马蹄周围散开，逐渐融入几乎没有具体景物的浅色前景。左侧骑手周围的暖色颜料与右侧人物旁的冷青绿色区域相接。光线漫射而富有空气感，没有坚硬的投影；浅色地面与浅色马身在较暗骑手下方承载最明亮的高光。宽阔的刮擦痕、干涩的黑线和薄透色层让部分场景显得尚未画满，少量饱和色重音则把人群凝聚起来。整体构图将骑手集中在中央横带，以活跃的破碎边缘和冷暖对比传达穿越雾气的动势。
style_prompt_en: Expressive painting combines translucent washes with broad opaque swipes, scraped passages, and sparse dry black lines. Forms emerge in clusters from the surrounding pale ground; contours alternate between sharp dark strokes and edges that dissolve into misty color. Warm vermilion, ocher, and yellow collide with turquoise and smoky blue-gray, while off-white gaps keep the dense marks breathable. Light is diffuse and appears to filter through layered pigment rather than strike surfaces as a hard beam. Repeated upright marks and staggered silhouettes create forward rhythm within a compressed middle band. Areas of rough grain and loose unpainted-looking space counterbalance concentrated color accents. The overall effect is vigorous, atmospheric, and intentionally open at the edges.
style_prompt_zh: 表现性绘画把半透明晕染与宽阔的不透明刷痕、刮擦区域和稀疏的干涩黑线结合起来。形体成簇地从周围浅色底面浮现；轮廓在锐利深色笔痕与融入雾状颜色的边缘之间交替。朱红、赭色和黄色同青绿、烟雾般的蓝灰相碰，灰白空隙让密集笔痕仍有呼吸感。光线漫射，像是穿过层层颜料，而非以硬光束照在表面。重复的竖向痕迹和错落的剪影在被压缩的中部横带里形成向前的节奏。粗颗粒区域与看似未画满的松散空间平衡集中的色彩重音。整体效果充满力度和空气感，边缘有意保持开放。
theme_en: A group of riders approaching through a loose cloud of dust
theme_zh: 一群骑手穿过松散扬起的尘雾迎面而来
name: Ted DeGrazia
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
